declaration.negotiation_history_statement: Whitcombe Reyes LLP proposed a $38 million class fund with automatic payments to identified class members, no separate attorneys’ fees, no clear-sailing provision, and no fee reversion. Brightline accepted that proposal in the first round, subject to court approval. There were no counteroffers or subsequent changes to the terms. The fee term was included in the initial proposal; it was not negotiated after agreement on class relief. The settlement remains subject to the Court’s independent review under Rule 23(e).
